# Proxmox Lab Platform instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` and `AI_CONTEXT.md`. This is classroom infrastructure software. Default-deny tenant access, persist every Proxmox mutation as a durable operation, require previews for destructive actions, keep secrets server-side, use linear Alembic migrations, regenerate the OpenAPI contract, and update the wiki with behavior changes. Never claim that mocks validate a live Proxmox deployment.
